text:
Maya: Hey team — posting the draft PRD for the telemetry/dashboard + trace retention UX we've been iterating on. Feedback needed before we lock scope for the sprint. Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/prds/telemetry-ui-retention-draft (please don't share externally)

Ben: skimmed. Two immediate engine constraints: trace sampling controls will add ~15% CPU overhead in worst case; we might need to limit realtime trace view to recent 10k traces or add pagination. Can we defer live heatmap til post-MVP?

Ashley: proto attached — /files/ux/trace-retention-flow-v3.png. Proposed flow: 1) retention tiers modal 2) per-route sampling toggle 3) preview query w/ estimates. Will upload figma link.

Jorge: For launch criteria we need clear metrics: 95th latency for dashboard < 300ms for cached data, and retention storage per org not exceed estimated budget. Also want a regression test that compares token-level billing before/after.

Maya: Proposed PRD acceptance criteria (quick):
```
- Dashboard list + single route view implemented
- Retention tiers UI: 7/30/90/365 day options
- Trace sampling controls per-route and global default
- Preview query that estimates storage & cost before apply
- Migration plan for existing orgs (auto-map defaults)
- UX flow passes usability test N=5 with no major blockers
- No P0 reliability regressions in canary for 72h
```

Ben: Agree on criteria but add: backend must expose cost estimate API under /v1/telemetry/cost-estimate and a batch update job for migrations. Also need graceful fallback when estimate API times out. Suggested timeout: 2s.

Ashley: Edge cases UX: empty state when retention < data window, error states for partial migration, clear copy for "cost estimate is approximate", and explainer tooltip for sampling impact. I'll draft microcopy.

Maya: Scope negotiation: can we defer the "heatmap" and "trace flamegraph" to post-launch? I'd like to keep MVP focused on retention controls + sampling + preview.

Ben: Yes — heatmap + flamegraph -> post-MVP. Prioritizing cost-estimate endpoint, sampling rollout support, and throttling. ETA for API: 3 sprints.

Jorge: On analytics: we need events for tier_change, preview_used, migration_started/migration_completed/migration_failed, and sampling_toggled. I'll add to events catalog and map to dashboards.

deploy-bot: RFC created: rfc/telemetry-retention-2026-03-19 — reviewers: @ben @maya @ashley @jorge

Maya: Thanks. Can everyone leave inline comments on the PRD by EOD Thursday? If we converge, I'll schedule a scoping session with eng + design next Monday.

Ben: Will do. Note: pushing heavy sampling recalculation to a dedicated job to avoid token spool-up on hot paths. Also we need a mitigation plan if migration job hits quota limits.

Ashley: I'll send updated prototype tomorrow AM and include the empty/error states.

Jorge: I'll propose target KPIs and a per-org retention cost budget by Friday.

Maya: Great — action items: @ben implement cost-estimate API RFC, @ashley update prototypes + copy, @jorge events + KPIs, team review PRD by Thu EOD. Thanks :raised_hands:
